# deepseek-cost-usage-status-plugin

A dynamic Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) showing live DeepSeek API cost / usage / balance: a second composer stats line with on/off-peak (Beijing-time windows, green/red in local time), session cost (official CNY pricing), ~¥/min burn, account balance, and current model.

- Design: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md)
- Plan: [docs/plan.md](docs/plan.md)
- Source: [package-source.js](package-source.js) (`host` → cordis_define `code.host`, `client` → `code.client`)
- Guide: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
